profile.headline: Django and React Full stack Developer.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
A multi-language, multi-domain platform operating across international markets. I worked across the entire development lifecycle, building and maintaining scalable web applications with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and user experience. My role was both frontend and backend development, as well as data automation.

What I did:
- Develop and maintain frontend applications
- Build and scale backend services 
- Design and manage databases 
- Create and maintain data-fetching and web-scraping bots to automate data collection
- Ensure frontend stability, performance optimization, and ongoing maintenance
- Collaborate across teams to support a high-traffic, multi-market platform
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Software Project Management and +12 skills

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
work was building and optimizing backend systems to deliver impactful solutions in the agricultural insurance sector. 

Key responsibilities include:
- Backend System Development: Implement, and optimize scalable backend systems to process and analyze weather data for agricultural insurance applications.
- Project Farmer Payout: Contributed to the development of a system that calculates and processes insurance payouts for farmers based on weather conditions. This system utilizes NASA weather data to assess the probability of weather events (e.g., drought, heavy rainfall) impacting crops.
- Data Integration & API Development: Developed and maintained APIs that integrate external weather data sources, ensuring reliable data flow for real-time decision-making in the payout process.
positions.insights: Back-End Web Development, Python (Programming Language) and +11 skills

positions.title: Full Stack Freelance Developer
positions.description:
●  Worked on web, mobile, desktop and scripting bots; basically anything code. Notable clients
included One Van (UK), Ninjabet among others.
● Major Programming languages used during this period include: C#, PHP , SQL, JavaScript, Python, HTML, mysql , mongo.
positions.insights: Django REST Framework, PHP and +4 skills
